notes: Route 1: Ma'mun asks and the Imam writes; the asker is only in the scene (rule 5), so the Imam «علي بن موسى الرضا» is the last link (imam_in_text, owner ruling 2).

Routes 2 and 3 are full isnads after the saying («وحدثني بذلك», «وحدثنا ... مثل حديث»). They are kept as groups; the text marks wording differences («إلا أنه لم يذكر»). The Imam after «عن» stays narrator.
«عمه أبي عبد الله محمد بن شاذان»: the uncle is dropped and the name stands alone (rule 7). «الحاكم» is part of the name as written.
Occurrence numbers on «الفضل بن شاذان» and «الرضا» count the identical words in the three routes.
